blocks.text: 大量工作已经交给 Agent 处理，从重构代码到整理消息。但每项任务都在各自的对话中推进。在重新拾起某一项之前，你必须在一堆对话中翻找上下文，并回想那项任务是做什么的。让 Agent 生成一个 HTML 仪表盘可以把信息汇集到一处，但页面只显示生成那一刻的数据。要让它保持更新、推进任务或保存结果，你必须回到聊天中重新解释一切。人与 AI 之间的工作从来不是只交接一次：有时需要人来修改，有时需要 AI 来协助。

inlines.text: Mini App

blocks.text: Mini App 是一个兼容 MiniMax Plugin 协议的扩展，在 miniapp.json 清单、前端和 Node.js 服务器之上构建。架构很直接：Node.js 服务器获取数据、保存结果，并通过托管的 MCP 将应用的功能暴露给 Agent。页面出现在对话侧边栏中，也可以弹出为独立窗口。进程、端口、身份验证、凭据以及支持回滚的发布均由宿主处理。

inlines.text: 首批官方 Mini App 中有几个是由我们工程团队之外的同事以这种方式构建的：
一个股票仪表盘 Mini App，将分散在知识星球（Zsxq）、金门财经和腾讯文档中的股票信息汇集到一个仪表盘中。

MiniMax Bot 本身就是一个 Mini App。主 Bot 负责组建团队，将长时间运行的任务交给后台 Agent 对话，然后审查并汇报结果。这些对话中的 Agent 可以反过来调用 Bot 的工具来发送消息、保存和搜索记忆。大多数 Bot 更新只需改动插件，无需等待 MiniMax Code 发布新版本。其源代码现已进入开源社区仓库。

blocks.text: 开源社区的开发者们也开始构建自己的 Mini App：一个按日期和模型展示 token 用量的仪表盘、用于以泳道图浏览 Git 历史的 Git Commit Tree，以及用于回放对话模型轨迹的 Session Trajectory。有些则偏向日常生活与创意工作，比如用于记录心情并抽取每日灵感卡的 Xinyu Island，以及由 Agent 创建和编辑交互式图表的 Anatomy Gallery。

blocks.text: “从早期工作流到 RAG 和 Agentic Search，再到受我们在 MiniMax 工作的启发，我发现专业工作需要的不仅仅是一个花哨的 Agent：而是一个原生、紧密集成的环境，让 Agent 和人紧密协作。作为一名金融分析师，我过去大部分时间都花在收集零散信息上。现在 Mini Apps 把这些信息带进了我的工作区，我可以专注于思考和判断，把整理、分析、梳理信息完全交给 Mini Apps。”
— MiniMax 产品经理
关于安全：账户凭据由宿主持有，插件和页面均无法访问。连接器和 Agent 权限必须在 manifest 中声明后才能使用。Mini App 的服务器端口仅对其自身页面和 Agent 开放。当页面想要向 Agent 传递内容时，内容会先进入你的输入框，以便你在发送前审阅和编辑。Mini App 代码以你的身份在你的机器上运行，因此请只安装来自可信来源的包。

blocks.text: A lot of work is already handed to Agents, from refactoring code to sorting through messages. But each task moves forward in its own conversation. Before picking one back up, you have to dig through a pile of conversations for the context and remember what that one was for. Asking the Agent for an HTML dashboard pulls the information into one place, but the page only shows the data from the moment it was generated. To keep it updated, push a task forward, or save results, you have to go back to the chat and explain everything again. Work between people and AI is never handed off just once: sometimes it needs a human’s revisions, and sometimes it needs the AI to pitch in.

blocks.text: Mini Apps

inlines.text: Mini Apps

blocks.text: A Mini App is an extension compatible with the MiniMax Plugin protocol, with a miniapp.json manifest, a frontend, and a Node.js server added on top. The architecture is straightforward: the Node.js server fetches data, saves results, and exposes the app’s features to the Agent through hosted MCP. The page appears in the conversation sidebar and can pop out into its own window. Processes, ports, authentication, credentials, and rollback-capable publishing are all handled by the host.

inlines.text: Today’s release has three parts:
The Mini App runtime: a Node backend with a persistent data directory, hosted MCP, the Agent API, Host Connectors, and tool approvals handled right in the page
/miniapp-creator

Official Mini Apps in the plugin marketplace, plus MiniMax-Code-MiniApps, the open-source community repository

blocks.text: With /miniapp-creator, the Agent first runs a read-only query against each data source to confirm it can get real data. Then it writes the page and the backend, publishes the app, opens it, and checks the result with screenshots in the built-in browser.

blocks.text: Several of the first official Mini Apps were built this way by colleagues outside our engineering team:

inlines.text: Several of the first official Mini Apps were built this way by colleagues outside our engineering team:
A stock dashboard Mini App brings stock information scattered across Knowledge Planet (Zsxq), Jinmen Finance, and Tencent Docs into a single dashboard.
CadQuery Viewer lets you mark positions on a 3D model and send them back to the conversation for the Agent to change.
Self-drive Route Planner combines map routing, place search, and image generation into one trip-planning workspace.

MiniMax Bot is itself a Mini App. The main bot assembles a team, hands long-running tasks to background Agent conversations, then reviews and reports on the results. Agents in those conversations can in turn call the Bot’s tools to send messages and to save and search memories. Most Bot updates only require a plugin change, with no need to wait for a MiniMax Code release. Its source code is now in the open-source community repository.

blocks.text: Developers in the open-source community have started building their own Mini Apps, too: a dashboard of token usage by date and model, Git Commit Tree for browsing Git history as a swimlane graph, and Session Trajectory for replaying a conversation’s model trajectory. Some lean toward everyday life and creative work, like Xinyu Island, for logging your mood and drawing a daily inspiration card, and Anatomy Gallery, where the Agent creates and edits interactive diagrams.

blocks.text: “From early workflows to RAG and Agentic Search, and inspired by our work at MiniMax, I’ve found that professional work needs something more than a flashy Agent: a native, tightly integrated environment where Agents and people work closely together. As a financial analyst, I used to spend most of my time pulling together scattered information. Now that Mini Apps bring it into my workspace, I can focus on thinking and judgment, and leave organizing, analyzing, and working through the information entirely to the Mini Apps.”
— Product Manager at MiniMax

On security: account credentials are held by the host, and neither plugins nor pages can access them. Connectors and Agent permissions must be declared in the manifest before they can be used. A Mini App’s server port is open only to its own pages and the Agent. When a page wants to pass something to the Agent, the content goes into your input box first, so you can review and edit it before sending. Mini App code runs on your machine as you, so only install packages from sources you trust.
